anomalies.description: A man lying on the ground fires a handgun; muzzle flash and smoke are visible at the barrel in frame f2 (5.0s), confirming discharge.; A man lying on the ground fires a handgun; visible muzzle flash and smoke at frame f10 (5.0s) and continued recoil/smoke at f11 (5.5s).; One of the two standing officers fires his handgun; visible muzzle flash and smoke at frame f12 (6.0s), with continued smoke and recoil at f13 (6.5s).
The same man on the ground fires again; visible muzzle flash and smoke in frame f4 (6.0s) and continued recoil posture in f5 (6.5s).
A man in a dark suit is thrown backward over the roof of a black convertible car during a physical confrontation; his body is airborne and inverted between frames f0–f3, landing on the car at f4.

A man stands over a motionless person lying on the ground while holding a firearm, indicating an attack on a helpless victim.
A man in a black leather coat is shown aiming and firing a handgun at a prone figure on the ground; muzzle flash is visible in frame f1 and sustained aiming occurs through f3.

The same man is seen raising and aiming a handgun again, with clear arm extension and weapon orientation toward off-screen target; no muzzle flash visible but posture strongly indicates firing action.
A car's rear wheel spins violently with smoke and sparks, indicating loss of traction or a burnout during rapid acceleration or skid, consistent with a vehicular incident.

A black sedan collides with another vehicle (likely the silver sedan visible in frame f6), causing sparks and visible damage; the black car's undercarriage scrapes the road, producing a trail of sparks.; The black sedan, now damaged and sparking, continues moving and appears to sideswipe or collide with a parked silver sedan at an intersection, causing further sparks and displacement of the silver car.

A silver sedan (likely a Honda Accord) is struck from the side or rear, causing it to skid sideways with visible sparks from undercarriage scraping the road surface; the impact and resulting motion are evident across frames f0–f4.

A black Jaguar XJ-S (or similar model) is shown mid-collision or immediate aftermath: its right rear wheel is lifted off the ground, body is severely damaged on the right side, and sparks fly from contact with the pavement; consistent with a high-speed side impact or spin-out.

A man in a black leather jacket is seen standing on the roof of a silver car, arms outstretched, holding a handgun in his right hand; muzzle flash is not visible, but the posture and weapon are clearly depicted in f13–f14, indicating an active shooting stance during a confrontation.
A man in a black leather jacket aims and fires a handgun directly at the camera; muzzle flash is visible in frame f2 (49.0s), and the gun is held in firing position.

A black sedan is struck, causing its driver-side door to open violently and a person to be ejected or thrown from the vehicle; visible in frames f5–f7 as the car moves rapidly with occupant partially outside.
A man in a leather jacket aims and fires a handgun; muzzle flash is visible at the barrel tip in frame f0.
A silver sedan collides with another vehicle or object, initiating a violent rollover and explosion sequence; visible impact and initial fire in frames f2–f3.
A silver car erupts in a massive fireball, lifting off the ground and flipping vertically; sustained explosive combustion with debris and smoke across frames f10–f15.
The vehicle impacts the ground and continues to burn violently; sustained fire, smoke, and structural disintegration observed through frames f9–f15.
A vehicle is shown overturned and engulfed in large flames on a city street at night, indicating a recent severe crash.
